name: Minimum
description: Small, honest performance mod. Skips draw calls of idle particle systems, caps particle pool sizes, throttles drawing while the game is in the background, optional Draw Divide, tab-out volume. Has an on-screen stats line so you can see it working.

mod-enabled.name: Enable Minimum
mod-enabled.description: Master switch. Turn it off to compare with and without the mod (no restart needed).

show-stats.name: Show Stats Line
show-stats.description: Small line in the top-left corner: frames drawn per second, logic-only frames, particle draws skipped. Turn it off once you have confirmed the mod works.

skip-idle-particles.name: Skip Idle Particle Draws
skip-idle-particles.description: Do not issue a draw call for particle systems that have no live particles. No visual change.

cap-particles.name: Cap Particle Pool Size
cap-particles.description: Limits how many particles one particle system can hold. Only affects systems created after the change, so re-enter the level. Lower cap = more FPS in particle-heavy levels, thinner effects.

particle-cap.name: Particle Cap
particle-cap.description: Max particles per system. 128 keeps normal effects intact and trims extreme particle spam. 32 is aggressive.

background-throttle.name: Throttle Drawing In Background
background-throttle.description: While the game window is not focused, draw at Background FPS. Game logic and audio keep running normally. Turn off if you record the game with OBS window capture while it is unfocused.

background-fps.name: Background FPS
background-fps.description: Draw rate while the game window is not focused.

background-volume.name: Lower Volume When Tabbed Out
background-volume.description: Drops music and SFX when the window loses focus so other audio is clearer.

draw-divide.name: Draw Divide
draw-divide.description: OFF by default. Draws at Visual FPS while game logic keeps running at the full frame rate. Only useful if your FPS is higher than your screen refresh rate (FPS bypass / uncapped). Do NOT use together with the mat.draw-divide mod.

visual-fps.name: Visual FPS
visual-fps.description: Draw rate when Draw Divide is on. Set it to your monitor refresh rate (60, 144, 240).

fast-alt-tab.name: Fast Alt Tab
fast-alt-tab.description: Skips the game save that happens when the window loses focus, so alt-tab does not stutter. Saving on level exit and on closing the game is untouched.
